title: fix(mcp): slim the open door's tools/list; the served SKILL.md carries the teaching and names validate_expression's variables
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DDxdrYJq965rUfrZBso8FS3)_
Part of #34689
Fixes #33272
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:接入自建应用 MCP 的每个 AI 客户端,一连上要读的工具清单从约 48 KB 降到约 36 KB;工具怎么调用不变,讲解性文字挪到了服务端提供的技能说明里。
- 为什么做:属于「MCP 二期与问数」专题,替每个接入方省下每次连接都要付的 token。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是某个客户端在没装技能时少看到一段用法讲解、调用质量下降;只改了说明文字,可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

**#34689: the open door's `tools/list` is slimmed.** Measured on this branch's base (`c0716ed4`) by the new `packages/mcp/src/tools-list-weight-34689.test.ts`: the API-key surface of a self-hosted app (17 tools, the dataset descriptions being the real service-analytics definitions) through a real `tools/list` round-trip.

| | before (`c0716ed4`) | after (`6367695c`) |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `tools/list` response | **47,712** | **36,226** (-24%) |
| all descriptions | 21,192 | 11,479 |
| descriptions `packages/mcp` owns | 18,213 | 8,500 (-53%) |
| all input schemas | 23,344 | 21,637 |

Per tool, bytes (description / input schema):

| tool | before | after |
|:--|--:|--:|
| validate_expression | 2,795 / 4,812 | 633 / 3,671 |
| aggregate_records | 1,618 / 3,943 | 915 / 3,943 |
| query_dataset (service-analytics + spec) | 826 / 4,591 | 826 / 4,591 |
| query_records | 2,070 / 1,853 | 736 / 1,853 |
| run_action | 2,137 / 1,110 | 1,228 / 884 |
| list_datasets (service-analytics) | 2,153 / 490 | 2,153 / 490 |
| delete_records | 1,478 / 888 | 763 / 888 |
| get_record | 847 / 1,296 | 285 / 1,228 |
| delete_record | 1,171 / 962 | 783 / 894 |
| resume_run | 1,499 / 488 | 716 / 488 |
| create_upload_link | 1,804 / 895 | 794 / 827 |
| read_file | 623 / 689 | 444 / 621 |
| describe_object | 1,051 / 223 | 459 / 223 |
| list_actions | 859 / 114 | 483 / 114 |
| update_record | 42 / 528 | 42 / 460 |
| create_record | 73 / 348 | 73 / 348 |
| list_objects | 146 / 114 | 146 / 114 |

Round 2 (L1 note 3): the weight test's stub bridge now serves `createUploadLinkForNewRecord` like the runtime bridge, so both columns were re-measured with it (round 1 read 46,827 → 35,614 without it); run_action regained "nothing ran; do not retry unless the user asks" (+90 B). The card read 40,341 bytes on `a0326b06`; the surface grew to 47,712 before this branch, so the before column is re-measured, not copied.

Each description keeps what a call needs without the skill: its arguments, the confirmation a destructive call takes, the refusal it may answer and what to do then. What moved to the served SKILL.md (`packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts`, rendered at `/api/v1/mcp/skill`, and its Console mirror byte for byte):

- `describe_object`: the readonly / defaultValue / validation-message facts.
- `query_records`: the `latestPer` and `expand` worked examples, what `source` names, and the approvals-waiting-on-you filter (a new Conventions bullet). The person-field lookup was already there.
- `aggregate_records`: select-order, currency naming and the lookup-label rule, under the `query_records` entry (it registers only where the host carries an aggregate member; the Console's tool-list pin holds the bullet list to every caller's tools).
- `get_record`: the `related` example.
- `run_action`: the `FLOW_FAILED` relay (the answer's second text block already carries the reason, chosen in the console's read order).
- `create_upload_link`: the read-only, `readonlyWhen` and approval-lock cases (in the conditional file-tool lines).
- `validate_expression`: its description now names the facts to pass per site and points at the skill, which already listed every check by site; it gains the date-equality warning.

The rest was cut outright where the answer already says it (the withheld-fields note, the recycle-bin restore route, which the skill keeps).

**Tombstones, decided per tool.**
- `aggregate_records` `aggregations[].distinct` (its description 1,098 bytes): **rides in `tools/list`.** It is the spec's own `AggregationNodeSchema`, taken whole on purpose (the code forbids a local copy of the entry), and its description is the same string the refusal prints. Taking it out of `tools/list` alone needs a rewrite layer over the SDK's schema output, a new mechanism; shortening it changes the refusal's wording. Both are out of this card.
- `run_action` / `resume_run` retired `confirm`: **refusal alone**, unchanged: the member is already absent from `tools/list` and refused with its prescription.

No other tombstone is in `tools/list`.

**#33272: the skill names `variables`.** The served SKILL.md and its Console mirror list `variables?` in `validate_expression`'s signature, and say that at a `flow_condition` the shadowed-read warning, and the binding of a bare name to the variable rather than the field, need it. Checked against the merged contract (PR #33255): the handler refuses `variables` at any other site.

**Pins moved (old answer, then new answer, and the card behind it):**
- `mcp-system-object-ai-read.test.ts` (#32442): `query_records`' description carried the My Pending filter, now the served skill carries it (#34689 moves worked examples to the skill).
- `mcp-action-refusal-details.test.ts` (#32757): `run_action`'s description taught the read order `details.errorMessage`, then `userMessage`, then `details.innerRefusal.message`; now both descriptions point at the second text block, and the read order stays pinned on the answer in the same file (#34689).

Every other description pin holds as it was, including the delete approval rule in both the description and the `confirm` member, the #34877 author's-or-platform's description sentence, the ranking and `totalGroups` sentences, and the file-tool new-record wording.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run src/tools-list-weight-34689.test.ts` prints the table above and asserts the total stays under 38,000 bytes.

Read first, by risk: `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` (the `run_action` and `validate_expression` description hunks); `packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts` (the moved text); the two moved pins.

<details><summary>Local derived gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on `73c5d9bc` derived 71 families; all 71 run, exit codes captured before any pipe; `--ran` reconciliation: `71 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 69 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (2 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`.

- 68 exit 0.
- NOT MEASURED, prerequisite: `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exit 3 (its positive control is pinned to a commit this shallow checkout cannot reach); `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`: about 48 packages have no `dist/` in this worktree).
- NOT MEASURED, prerequisite: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` exit 1: `Test Files 2 failed | 169 passed`, both failures `Failed to resolve entry for package "@objectstack/client"` (not built here). The diff touches no `ui/scripts/` input.

CI runs all three.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The card's "no tool's call success drops in a scenario ask round run before and after" is owed and is routed through the seat to the eval seat; no live LLM round was run here.
- Left for their owners (not edited; outside this card's file surface): `list_datasets` / `query_dataset` descriptions (2,979 bytes) are the service-analytics definitions; `query_dataset`'s 4,591-byte schema is the spec's `QueryDatasetInputSchema`; `validate_expression`'s `variables` items carry the spec's `FlowVariableSchema` descriptions (1,838 bytes, one of them a 1,000-byte paragraph on record-reference inputs). They are the largest remaining blocks.
- Three commits: one per card, plus a follow-up that moved the `aggregate_records` skill text from its own bullet to under `query_records` after the Console's tool-list pin went red on it.
